Thanks for the tag, Jonas. My suggested position below — keeps us commercially usable while protecting BrightGrid's brand controls.

Recommended clause (for counter):
"Subject to Customer's brand guidelines (provided in Schedule X), Company may use Customer's name and logo in marketing and sales materials, limited to: (i) press announcements jointly agreed in writing (each party may embargo for up to 14 calendar days prior to public release), (ii) product pages, case studies, solution one-pagers, and slide decks used with prospects or investors, and (iii) corporate blog posts. Use in paid advertising campaigns, sponsored content, or any co-branded paid placements requires prior written approval from the Customer (such approval not to be unreasonably withheld). Company shall redact identifying information from any demo or excerpt used in a public demo where Customer did not provide explicit consent."

Note: I swapped "no paid ads" for a requirement of prior approval — that keeps our GTM channels open while respecting brand control. For anonymization, define as: "removal of name, logos, unique identifiers, and any specific contract value or region references."

If Olga and Lauren sign off, we send this counter back to Emma and propose a single DocuSign for MSA + Order Form. I recommend we retain the 14-day embargo.

Karthik
